sections.text_helper: Section 6.4.9 "RCC AHB peripheral reset register (RCC_AHBRSTR)" in chapter 6 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 144.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x28
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:13 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 12 CRCRST: CRC reset
Set and cleared by software.
0: No effect
1: Reset CRC
Bits 11:9 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 8 FLASHRST: Flash memory interface reset
Set and cleared by software.
0: No effect
1: Reset flash memory interface
This bit can only be set when the flash memory is in power down mode.
Bits 7:1 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 0 DMA1RST: DMA1 and DMAMUX reset
Set and cleared by software.
0: No effect
1: Reset DMA1 and DMAMUX
